segments.text: Usage text. "Fail-loud" means here: the generator must stop with an error when its input is wrong, and it must not write a page. make_report.py is the generator of the report page of the rerun. Its input is facts.json, the file with one record per timed interval.
Modules of the Python standard library.

- `S` is the folder of this script.
- `T` is a new temporary folder inside `S/test-tmp`. Every file that the test writes goes there.
- `src` is the text of make_report.py.
- `facts` is the parsed content of facts.json.
segments.heading: Setup: temporary folder and the two inputs

segments.text:
Prepare the case `name`:
- Copy the facts in memory, damage the copy with `mutate`, and write it to `facts-<name>.json` in the temporary folder.
- In the text of the generator, replace `S + "/facts.json"` by the path of the damaged copy. This text occurs 2 times: where the generator reads the file, and in its reference list [Ref1].
- Replace the line that sets `OUT`, the path of the report page, by a path in the temporary folder.
- The `assert` stops the test when the text did not change or when the new output path is not in it.
- `patch` may change the text once more. The default changes nothing.
- Write the text to `gen-<name>.py`.
segments.heading: Function `run`: one test case

segments.text:
- Run the copy as a separate process with the same Python program. Collect its standard output and its error output as text.
- Keep the lines that hold `FAIL`, `STOP` or `NOT WRITTEN`, or that start with `wrote`. The generator prints `STOP` when it ends early, `FAIL` for a failed self-check, `NOT WRITTEN` after a failed self-check, and `wrote` after it wrote the page [Ref1].
- Print the case name, the exit status, and whether the output file exists.
- Print the first 4 kept lines, each cut to 230 characters.
- Return the exit status.

`drop_one` deletes the first part L record (`rerun-L`) of the kernel `oldread`. It also lowers the stored record count by 1, so the generator's test of the total count still passes. In the saved run the generator stopped with: part L, oldread: expected 6 interval records, found 5 [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `drop_one`: one part L record removed

segments.text: `change_a` takes the first record of part A (`rerun-A`) with binary `bw_new` and kernel `read` (the new read kernel) in session 1, round 1. It raises the rate `GBps` by 5.0 GB/s (from 330.59 to 335.59 GB/s with the current facts.json). In the saved run the generator stopped with: threads120.csv line 11: not the interval row of this record [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `change_a`: one part A rate changed

segments.text: `change_bwx` raises by 0.5 GB/s the rate of the first part C record (`rerun-C`) of the kernel `read`. In the saved run the generator stopped with: sum of the T rows 320.900964 is not the record value 321.401 (both in GB/s) [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `change_bwx`: one part C rate changed

segments.text: `change_bwx_old` raises by 0.5 GB/s the rate of the first record of the data set `B7a` with the kernel `read` at position 6. `B7a` is an earlier 8000 MT/s run with the older runner bwx. In the saved run the generator stopped with: sum of the T rows 319.107060 is not the record value 319.607 (both in GB/s) [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `change_bwx_old`: one rate of runner bwx changed

segments.text: `drop_bwx_old` deletes the first `asmread` record of the data set `B5a-rev` and lowers the stored count by 1. `B5a-rev` is an earlier 8000 MT/s run with the runner bwx in reverse kernel order. In the saved run the generator stopped with: runner bwx, reverse order, asmread: expected 4 interval records, found 3 [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `drop_bwx_old`: one record of runner bwx removed

segments.text: `change_10mod` raises by 0.5 GB/s the rate of the first record of the data set `X1d10` with the kernel `asmread` at position 1. `X1d10` is an earlier bwx12 run in a boot with 10 memory modules. In the saved run the generator stopped with: sum of the T rows 260.369381 is not the record value 260.869 (both in GB/s) [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `change_10mod`: one rate of a 10-module boot changed

segments.text: `drop_x2d12` deletes the first `oldread` record at position 0 of the data set `X2d12` and lowers the stored count by 1. `X2d12` is an earlier bwx12 run at 8000 MT/s with 12 memory modules. In the saved run the generator stopped with: X2d12, oldread at position 0: expected 2 interval records, found 1 [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `drop_x2d12`: one record of data set X2d12 removed

segments.text: `bwx_load` finds the first `read` record of the data set `C3b`, an earlier 8000 MT/s run with the runner bwx. In every record of the same process (same `proc_key`) it raises `load1_at_launch`, the load at launch, by 1.0. In the saved run the generator stopped with: not the header line of the process of this record (tag, binary, launch time or load differs) [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `bwx_load`: load at launch of one process changed

segments.text: `other_boot` replaces the boot id of the first `asmread` record of control I by an id of zeros. The record then looks like a record from another boot. In the saved run the generator stopped with: the 7200 MT/s records are not from one boot [Ref2].
segments.heading: Function `other_boot`: one record with another boot id

segments.text:
Call `run` once per case, one case after the other, and store each exit status in `res` under a description.
- The first case changes nothing. It is the control.
- The next 9 cases use one damage function each.
- The last case leaves the facts unchanged. It changes the text of the generator: the path of the earlier report gets a file name that does not exist. In the saved run the generator stopped with: the earlier report does not exist [Ref2].
- The earlier report is the report page of 2026-11-15 (`whole-chip-read-drop-easy-read.html`). The generator reads it and lists it as a reference [Ref1].
segments.heading: The 11 cases

segments.text:
- `ok` is true when the control gave exit status 0 and every other case gave a value other than 0.
- Print one line per case: `PASS` when the control gave 0 or a damaged case gave another value, else `FAIL`.
- Only the exit status is tested. The fact `output file written` of line 32 is printed for the reader, and no code tests it.
- An exit status other than 0 from a Python error that the generator does not catch would also count as a stop.
segments.heading: Verdict

segments.text: Delete the temporary folder with all copies. End with exit status 0 when `ok` is true, else with 1.
